verdict.rationale: Firebase Security Rules are documented as a flexible configuration language that defines what data each user can access across Cloud Firestore, Realtime Database and Cloud Storage, at whatever granularity the app needs. Community reports corroborate this: one user praises how access policy is separated from data logic, and another notes that failed attempts are blocked by security rules. missing for 10: concrete first-party examples of per-user rule conditions (e.g., matching on the authenticated user's ID), documented rules testing.
